notablePrerequisites: Auton Soldier is a copy of Kiki-Jiki.
description:
Activate Auton Soldier by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste that will be sacrificed at the next end step.
The Auton Soldier token enters the battlefield as a nonlegendary copy of Kiki-Jiki with an additional +1/+1 counter.
Activate the Auton Soldier token by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste, exile that token at the end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.
